about: Agent evaluation tasks (spec 13.7). Each task gives an agent a working folder and a prompt; the checks score the result with the dedalo binary. Seed files come from the golden corpus.

tasks.prompt: Write dungeon.dedalo: a small crypt with an entrance hall, a guard room north of it and a burial chamber east of the guard room. Join them with doors. Put a pressure-plate trap in the entrance and three skeletons in the guard room.
Write vault.dedalo: two rooms, a study and a hidden vault. The vault must not appear on player maps, and the only way in is a secret door from the study. Put a chest in the vault.
Write mine.dedalo: two caves that do not touch, joined by a two-cell-wide corridor. Add rubble terrain in one cave and a lit torch on a wall of the other.
Write temple.dedalo: a circular sanctum of radius 4 with an altar at its centre, entered from a rectangular antechamber to its south through an archway.
Write tavern.dedalo: a tavern cellar of two rooms with a trapdoor down. Declare two exports: a DM map as PDF and a player map as PNG at 70 pixels per cell without the grid.
Write keep.dedalo: a ruined keep of at least eight rooms on two wings, every room reachable from the gate, with at least one locked door and one light source per wing.
